artefacts_to_freeze: sample-frame snapshot file + source + date + retrieval method + SHA256
selected vendor list + full ordered draw + reserves (committed as hash first; plaintext only in sealed bundle)
journey mapping per vendor (object, effect, nonce field, fixtures, pre-existing setup)
agent configuration (model id+version, settings, tool policy, timeout, network policy) + SHA256
credential/configuration policy (scopes; supplied vs discovered; keyed fingerprints only, no secret values)
verifier specifications + code hash + passing hostile-offline-test hashes
statistical analysis plan (Wilson params, bootstrap seed, sensitivity list)
run IDs / run matrix (NxK) with seed-derived randomised order
evidence schema firstcall.programmeA.receipt.v1 + canonical-JSON hashing algorithm

must_not_exist_yet: any real vendor run, credential use, or outcome datum
freeze_1_boundary.chronology: Freeze 1 (protocol) -> Freeze 2 (frame & method) -> Freeze 3 (blind draw, hashed) -> Freeze 4 (apparatus & mappings from public docs) -> Freeze 5 (seal & reveal) -> execution
freeze_1_boundary.invariant: science sealed before selection; vendor list hash-committed before reveal; editing Freeze-1 content after Freeze 2 voids dependent selection

freeze_sequence.name: Protocol
freeze_sequence.content: this protocol + schemas hashed (estimand, journey standard, outcome taxonomy, run design, sample-frame RULES, analysis plan, freeze sequence, receipt schema)

freeze_sequence.name: Frame & method
freeze_sequence.content: snapshot, selection algorithm, RANDOMISATION_SEED as hash, SAP

freeze_sequence.name: Blind draw
freeze_sequence.content: run deterministic draw; commit HASH of ordered vendor list + reserves

freeze_sequence.name: Apparatus
freeze_sequence.content: runner/verifier/classifier/analysis code + hostile offline tests pass; per-vendor mappings from public docs only

freeze_sequence.name: Seal & reveal
freeze_sequence.content: reveal seed + vendor plaintext inside sealed bundle; verify matches Freeze-3 hash; only now eligibility checks then runs begin

invariant: no real run before Freeze 5; any change to Sections 1-9 after Freeze 5 invalidates the cohort and requires new pre-registration; vendor selection can never be edited after outcomes visible
